def factor_overnight_intraday_reversal_ema(df):
    """Overnight-intraday reversal signal smoothed with EMA, no volume scaling."""
    df_copy = df.copy()
    close = df_copy["close"]
    open_price = df_copy["open"]

    # Decompose returns
    overnight_ret, intraday_ret = alpha_tools.decompose_overnight_intraday(close, open_price)

    # Exponentially smooth returns for recent emphasis
    span = 20
    smooth_overnight = overnight_ret.ewm(span=span, adjust=False).mean()
    smooth_intraday = intraday_ret.ewm(span=span, adjust=False).mean()

    # Reversal signal: -overnight + intraday
    signal = -smooth_overnight + smooth_intraday
    df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_reversal_ema"] = signal
    return df_copy["factor_overnight_intraday_reversal_ema"]
description: Preserves the core overnight-intraday reversal mechanism from the parent, but replaces the simple rolling mean with an exponential moving average to give more weight to recent observations, improving responsiveness. Removes the volume burst scaling to focus on the raw reversal signal and reduce noise, targeting improved stability (ICIR/RankICIR) while retaining the economic interpretation of overnight reversal and intraday continuation.
